runs: out-1 and out-2 byte-equal; both use production OLD Zig and OLD Rust routes
normalization: Only random session ids become SESSION. hello/snapshot/ping are excluded from transcript frames on both sides.
images: Captured body.images and data.images are literal OLD maps. No HAND overlay.
native: native-raw preserves full and per-line Zig stdout/stderr as hex, including exact numeric/depth data. native-lines joins OLD per-line events with physical input offsets for representable contexts.
HAND: G1 wrappers/offsets follow protocol 2; Source.page omits route-only display/patch/find/images. G2/G3 compare all fields. A captured HTTP 500 becomes caller Fault::Core at that boundary.
legacy: tests/transcript_agy remains byte-equal, including guard/numeric token assertions and the two-row full projection. G1/G2 keep OLD empty page-upsert values separate.
gaps: Protocol-2 native guard/number transport for unrepresentable numbers is not asserted; legacy protocol-1 native tests stay unchanged.
Hard-input combinations, lease/cancel/shrink stress, new tools/schema/image/question forms and unusual path moves stay prototype gaps.
